A reliable answer needs a repo-wide search for callers of SymbolIndex.get_call_chain. Description: this method returns call chains for a symbol by traversing the internal reference map under a lock. The direction argument selects callers (up), callees (down), or both. For each depth level it walks references, skipping definitions and the symbol itself, appending records with symbol, file, line, and depth. It returns a dict with symbol, callers_chain, callees_chain, and total_connected. Edge cases: max_depth limits traversal, visited sets prevent cycles and duplicates, and missing symbols yield empty chains.
